courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 工程數位模型碰撞檢查
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何以掃描驗證竣工幾何」與「點雲與設計模型的偏差分析」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；工程數位模型碰撞檢查的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Why verify as-built geometry by scanning" and "Deviation analysis between cloud and design model" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of BIM-based construction clash detection must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以量測不確定度、精度等級、控制配準與偏差分析，判定竣工幾何能否交給下一工序；工程數位模型碰撞檢查則以以空間預算、共用座標、碰撞規則與協調循環，在施工前消除結構與機電之間的空間衝突為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on measurement uncertainty, accuracy levels, controlled registration and deviation analysis that decide whether as-built geometry can pass to the next trade; BIM-based construction clash detection centres on space budgets, shared coordinates, clash rules and coordination cycles that remove structure–services conflicts before construction, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「竣工偏差與量測不確定度」與「天花板內管線空間」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到工程數位模型碰撞檢查，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “As-built deviation and measurement uncertainty” and “Ceiling service void”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to BIM-based construction clash detection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Clash grouping, false positives and model quality", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 施工測量控制網
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何以掃描驗證竣工幾何」與「點雲與設計模型的偏差分析」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；施工測量控制網的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Why verify as-built geometry by scanning" and "Deviation analysis between cloud and design model" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Construction surveying control networks must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以量測不確定度、精度等級、控制配準與偏差分析，判定竣工幾何能否交給下一工序；施工測量控制網則以以誤差預算、坐標系統、穩定控制點與統計平差，讓放樣、貫通與監測都建立在可信的基準上為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on measurement uncertainty, accuracy levels, controlled registration and deviation analysis that decide whether as-built geometry can pass to the next trade; Construction surveying control networks centres on error budgets, coordinate systems, stable control points and statistical adjustment that give set-out, breakthrough and monitoring a trustworthy reference, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「竣工偏差與量測不確定度」與「主控制網」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到施工測量控制網，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “As-built deviation and measurement uncertainty” and “Primary control network”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Construction surveying control networks, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Static GNSS surveys and height conversion", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 建築雷射掃描竣工比對
history.text: 1990 年代 Ben Kacyra 等人開發可攜式雷射掃描儀 Cyrax，2001 年由徠卡測量系統收購，使地面雷射掃描逐漸進入測量與營建。非營利組織 CyArk 把掃描用於文化資產紀錄，2009 年掃描烏干達卡蘇比王陵，次年主陵毀於火災；Andrew Tallon 自 2010 年掃描巴黎聖母院，2019 年大火後成為修復參考。2011 年 ASTM 發布 E57 中立交換格式，2018 年 ISO 17123-9 訂定掃描儀現場檢定程序，USIBD 的 LOA 規範則提供指定與驗證精度的共同語言。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: In the 1990s Ben Kacyra and colleagues developed the Cyrax portable laser scanner, acquired by Leica Geosystems in 2001, which helped bring terrestrial laser scanning into surveying and construction. The non-profit CyArk applied scanning to heritage records, scanning the Kasubi Tombs in Uganda in 2009 a year before their main tomb burned; Andrew Tallon scanned Notre-Dame de Paris from 2010, and his data became a reference for restoration after the 2019 fire. In 2011 ASTM published the neutral E57 exchange format, in 2018 ISO 17123-9 set field test procedures for scanners, and the USIBD LOA specification provides a common language for specifying and verifying accuracy. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

references.scope: 整理 Tallon 自 2010 年掃描聖母院的移站次數與點數，以及資料在火災後的用途，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Summary of Tallon's Notre-Dame scanning from 2010, number of setups and points, and post-fire use of the data, for further reading.

roles.role: 地面雷射掃描儀與標靶配準流程的產品脈絡
roles.roleEn: Product context for terrestrial scanners and target-based registration
roles.business: 量測科技集團，旗下徠卡測量系統承接 Cyrax 技術，生產地面雷射掃描儀與點雲處理軟體。
roles.businessEn: Measurement-technology group whose Leica Geosystems unit carried forward the Cyrax technology and makes terrestrial laser scanners and point-cloud software.

roles.role: 建築竣工掃描與偏差分析的工具類型
roles.roleEn: Tool types for as-built building scans and deviation analysis
roles.business: 三維量測公司，生產相位式雷射掃描儀與現場掃描到模型的軟體。
roles.businessEn: 3D measurement company making phase-based laser scanners and scan-to-model software.

roles.role: 結合全測站控制與掃描的工地流程
roles.roleEn: Site workflows combining total-station control with scanning
roles.business: 定位與營建科技公司，提供掃描全測站、雷射掃描儀與點雲比對軟體。
roles.businessEn: Positioning and construction-technology company offering scanning total stations, laser scanners and point-cloud comparison software.

roles.role: 基準掃描支持災後重建的公開案例
roles.roleEn: Public cases of baseline scans supporting post-disaster reconstruction
roles.business: 以雷射掃描與攝影測量記錄文化資產的非營利組織，曾掃描卡蘇比王陵。
roles.businessEn: Non-profit that records heritage sites with laser scanning and photogrammetry, including the Kasubi Tombs.

courses.connection: 從「建築雷射掃描竣工比對」的材料、構件、施工或監測延伸到下列公司、業主與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購或背書。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies, owners and institutions related to the materials, members, construction or monitoring of Laser-scan verification of as-built construction. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement or endorsement.
